errors.kind: That is not a kind of catalog.
errors.id: That is not a record of this site.
errors.file: That is not an uploaded file.
errors.placementNumbers: Every placement field must be a number.
errors.placementNeeded: The frame's opening could not be measured from this picture. Fill in the four placement fields below, then save again. The picture you chose is kept.

notices.reset: The placement is back to the measured one.
notices.deactivated: It is still in use, so it is deactivated instead: whoever has it keeps it and nobody new can pick it.

placement.help: Percent of the avatar box. The frame is as wide as Width with its top left corner at Left and Top, and the avatar shrinks to the scale so that it fills the frame opening. A replaced picture is measured again unless you change a number.
placement.previewHelp: The preview follows the numbers as you type.

colourRows.colorHelp: A #rrggbb value. The colour picker and the field follow each other.
colourRows.foregroundHelp: The colour of text drawn on the accent.
colourRows.previewLabel: The colour on the two surfaces of the theme

catalog.deleteWarning: Deleting an entry that members, threads or shop items use deactivates it instead and keeps its picture.

frames.subtitle: Pictures drawn around a member avatar, shown around a sample avatar the way members get them. Members hold them through shop items.

covers.subtitle: The gallery members who may use it choose their profile cover from. Inactive covers leave the choices of members.

threadCovers.subtitle: Pictures a thread can wear. Members get them through shop items. Inactive covers can no longer be picked.

descriptionNew.frames: Upload the picture of the frame and name it. Its placement is measured from the picture.
descriptionNew.covers: Upload the picture of the cover and name it.
descriptionNew.threadCovers: Upload the picture of the cover and name it.

entryForm.pictureHelp: Uploaded as soon as you choose it. An entry needs a picture to be active.
entryForm.replaceHelp: Choose a file to replace the picture. The old file is deleted when you save.
entryForm.placementHelp: The numbers filled in are the placement of the frame now.
entryForm.placementHelpNew: Optional: fill all four fields to override the measured placement.

entryFields.name: Name
entryFields.positionHelp: Entries show in this order, lowest first.

palette.deleteWarning: Deleting a colour that members, shop items or thread prefixes use deactivates it instead.

accents.subtitle: The colours members can give the site. The first active accent is the site's own. Each accent has the colour of the text drawn on it.

nameColors.subtitle: The colours a member name can take. Members hold them through shop items. Also used for the colour of a group.

prefixColors.subtitle: The colours a thread prefix can take. Changing one changes every prefix that uses it.

descriptionNew.accent: An accent needs a colour and the colour of the text drawn on it.
descriptionNew.name: A colour for member names.

colourForm.activeHelp: Members and prefixes can pick this colour.
